sections.heading: Head of Department, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI & DS),
sections.content:
Profile :- Click Here
The Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI & DS), established in 2020 , has rapidly emerged as a hub of academic excellence and innovation. Our greatest strength lies in our highly motivated, multidisciplinary faculty—bringing together expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Analytics, AI engineering, and allied fields. Supported by dedicated technical and administrative staff, we provide students with a strong foundation to operate in a global, multicultural, rapidly evolving technological environment.
Our graduates have gone on to work with leading national and international corporations—joining firms at the cutting edge of AI, Data Science, Consulting, R&D, and analytics. Many have also taken up roles in startups and research labs, contributing meaningfully to solutions that impact society.
It is our hope that we will continue to deliver the highest standards in teaching, research, and ethical practice, thus serving society and humanity at large. We expect our students not only to absorb knowledge and skills during their stay with us, but to carry forward these values and contribute positively wherever they go.
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI & DS). The department is one of the fastest-growing disciplines, with a vision to create professionals who can address complex real-world challenges through innovation, research, and technology.
We, at the Department of AI & DS, are committed to creating a vibrant ecosystem where students evolve as innovators, leaders, and lifelong learners. I welcome all aspiring learners to be part of this journey and contribute to shaping a smarter, sustainable, and technology-driven future.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
sections.content:
It is a specialized engineering program focused on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Analytics technologies
Graduates can work as Data Scientists, AI Engineers, ML Engineers, Analysts, and Research Professionals.
Students primarily learn Python, R, SQL, Java, and C++.
The curriculum includes TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hadoop, Spark, and cloud platforms.
Yes, through internships, live projects, hackathons, industry visits, and research activities.
Candidates must complete 12th Science (PCM) and qualify as per state/national admission guidelines.
AI & DS focuses specifically on intelligent systems, data analytics, and machine learning applications.
Yes, the department offers placement training and campus recruitment support.
Yes, students can opt for M.Tech, MS abroad, MBA (Analytics), or Ph.D.
Yes, students are encouraged to publish papers, file patents, and participate in competitions.
